notes.title: Latex, Leather and Ropes: Explore your deepest Fetish Fantasies!
notes.content:
Hey sinners, we have exciting news to share with you today!

We've been working on something new that we're sure will tickle your fancy.
[h1]Fetish Club[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/ed07d3515ae893da027f7977d7003fd7702cde1e.jpg[/img]
The first rule of Fetish Club is: you do not talk about Fetish Club.
We've added more than 15 poses specifically designed for this game involving dynamic ropes and new props.
Here's a sneak peek of one of the scenes from the new game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/17dffc8dd7756747051809303f8efef4c3bc933f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/b032e61a7aba40cb127672130c36e345ef73f52e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/ddbe0d12f91ebda3b502c3f8f9dbe22fe42eaf1a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/00e9d3b619694c8db4da13a632241f645c960140.gif[/img]

But that's not all, a good old friend from SinVR is back, the spanking system has been rebuilt in PC and VR for a whole new experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/47611f40551ff490ad2802d77cf29fbd4ee4bd8b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/02dbfadce82e4a459e68b2414afbf04b297b9823.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/5ac90d40acfbe9a3d8e2c6a46b10e7aa87e21ce7.gif[/img]

Fetish Club is coming real soon, you can already whishlist Fetish Club [h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906170/Fetish_Club/]HERE[/url][/h3]
